review.headline: Easy 10 km completed as planned at 5:44/km with steady HR around 140.
observations: Distance 10.01 km against 10.0 planned, at 5:44/km, inside the 5:11-6:13 easy band.
Every km split was 344 s with HR between 138 and 142, so the effort stayed controlled and conversational.
Average HR of 140 and pace of 5:44 match the 4-week easy averages (346 s/km, 140 bpm), so this run fits the recent easy baseline.
flags: No RPE or note was logged, so the athlete's perceived effort is unknown.
